Subject: LumenAI — marketplace procurement & next steps

Hi Samantha / Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand LumenAI's inference needs and procurement model. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard from the call:
- Primary use: production inference for customer-facing features (conversational + reranking).
- Initial target region: US (with potential EU expansion H2).
- Desired timeline: contract finalized in ~6–8 weeks, procurement kick-off this month.

Procurement & commercial path questions
1) Billing method: Do you prefer Purchase Order (PO) billing or card for the initial contract? If PO, is there an internal PO template or specific terms we should expect?
2) Marketplace interest: you mentioned evaluating AWS Marketplace — is that the preferred commercial path or do you want a standard Redwood SaaS contract outside the marketplace?
3) Marketplace model: if AWS Marketplace is the path, do you need a private offer / negotiated pricing through Marketplace, or would a standard listing + invoice work?

I've attached our Redwood_Marketplace_Procurement_Guide and a standard SOW template so your procurement team can see the typical flow and contract artifacts.

Next steps I propose:
- Please confirm PO vs card and loop in procurement contact (cc Alex here if that's the right person).
- If AWS Marketplace is preferred, confirm who on your side will handle vendor onboarding so we can coordinate our marketplace team.

Attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_Procurement_Guide.pdf, Redwood_SOW_Template.docx

Thanks — I can be flexible on time next week for a follow-up with procurement if helpful.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Thanks Camila — appreciate the clear recap.

Short answers:
- Billing: Procurement prefers PO billing for anything > $25k/year. We'll need a standard PO template and the final invoice details (billing address, remit-to, W-9).
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is our preference for initial procurement — it simplifies purchasing for our finance team and helps with SSO/account provisioning. We may look at GCP Marketplace later, but AWS first.
- Offer type: We typically prefer a Private Offer on AWS Marketplace so finance can control pricing and approval flows. If Redwood supports private offers, that would be ideal.

Procurement contact: Alex Chen (copied) will lead procurement. Alex — can you confirm the PO template and the expected lead time for review? Our target is to have the contract signed within 6–8 weeks, but procurement needs to start this week to hit that.

Quoted from your attachments — I'll share the Procurement Guide with Alex.

Best,
Samantha

Thanks Samantha — great to know AWS Marketplace + private offer is preferred. Alex — really appreciate you jumping in. A few clarifications and the operational path from our side: 

1) Private Offer on AWS Marketplace
- Redwood supports AWS Marketplace private offers and can create a private offer with negotiated pricing. We will need a point of contact for the purchase order and any required contract redlines.
- Timeline: marketplace onboarding + private offer setup typically takes 2–4 weeks once commercial terms are agreed. There is some variability depending on AWS review.

2) PO vs Card
- If you're doing PO billing, we can accept POs for both our hosted Redwood (SaaS) offering and for Dedicated capacity. We'll provide our W-9, billing address, and an invoice contact. I'll attach a short LumenAI_PO_Template you can use to create the initial PO.

3) Docs & next steps
- Attached: LumenAI_PO_Template.docx (fillable) and the Procurement Guide I shared earlier.
- Please confirm: (a) preferred start date for service, (b) procurement contact (if different from Alex), and (c) whether you want us to initiate the AWS Marketplace private-offer paperwork now or wait until the PO is issued.

I'll also link the HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/879201/DEAL-2027-045

If helpful, I can set up a 30-minute sync this week with Alex + your procurement lead + our marketplace manager to move paperwork faster.

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Jonas: please engage the Marketplace onboarding team — primary ask is to confirm the 2–4 week private-offer setup estimate and flag any AWS requirements (seller account, entitlements, SaaS vs AMI packaging). If we can spin the private offer while procurement assembles the PO, that will help meet their 6–8 week window.
